data.one_liner: A numeric keyboard layout widget for Flutter with support for English and Arabic digits.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable numeric keypad widget that supports English and Arabic digits, custom left and right widgets around zero, and flexible styling options.
use_when: You need a custom numeric keypad inside your app UI rather than using the system software keyboard.
You need support for Arabic digits alongside English digits.
avoid_when: You want to rely entirely on the native platform's system keyboard for text fields.
You need complex full-keyboard layouts with letters and symbols.
strengths: Supports both English and Arabic digits with options to return values as English regardless of display.
Flexible customization including custom left and right widgets, radius, colors, and number styles.
